title: Chunin Exam
body:
Syntax: exam

Description: Enters the Forest of Death to attempt the Chunin Exam, required to advance from Genin to Chunin. Requires at least level 15 and 25 completed missions.

On entry, you receive either a Heaven Scroll or an Earth Scroll. Defeat animals and rival ninja to find the other scroll. Scroll guardians and rival exam candidates can carry the scroll you need. Once you have both, reach the central tower (VNUM 357) and ASK PROCTOR EXAM (or SUBMIT SCROLLS). The proctor consumes the scrolls and sends you to VNUM 670 for a final 1v1 against a stronger shadow of yourself. Win to become Chunin and earn your headband. Older Hell Scrolls are still accepted as Earth Scrolls.

Leaving with LEAVE CONFIRM or dying fails the exam and forfeits both scrolls; start a new attempt with EXAM.

Date: 2026-11-03
